summary.text: Anthony Ealy is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 36 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Republican Dave Thomas is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Ealy earned a bachelor's degree from Northwest Missouri State University in 2017 and a law degree from the University of Missouri School of Law in 2020.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ealy was assigned to the House Corrections and Public Institutions, Judiciary, Conservation and Natural Resources, House Economic Development and Transportation committees for 2025-2026.
